reuse.why: It builds on the single linkBankSyncAccount definition, but writes its own copy of unlinkAccount's link-clearing updateAccount rather than extracting a shared local-unlink helper that unlinkAccount also uses.

duplication.why: The eight-field reset (account_id, bank, balances, sync source, sync status) duplicates the block in unlinkAccount verbatim.

placement.why: The takeover lives in linkBankSyncAccount, the single link definition, and runs only after the closed-account check, so the guard order is preserved.

scope.why: Only the flag threading, the takeover in the shared link function and a release note are changed.

maintainability.why: Clear and well-commented, but the duplicated unlink field list must be kept in sync with unlinkAccount and the flag is threaded by hand through six provider wrappers.

bypasses_abstraction.where: accounts/app.ts linkBankSyncAccount: clears the previous holder with its own db.updateAccount instead of reusing unlinkAccount's local unlink logic (extracted into a helper)

disguised_duplication.where: The copied unlink reset is a plain verbatim copy, not disguised
